1Why Sell Lapland?

Lapland is located in the northernmost part of Finland and offers one of the most magical winter experiences in the world. Think Northern Lights, glass igloos, reindeer sleigh rides, and Santa Claus himself.

Lapland is highly seasonal, with peak travel from November to March for winter experiences, and September–March for Northern Lights viewing.

  • Bucket-list Arctic experience
  • Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis)
  • Official home of Santa Claus
  • Snow activities & winter safaris
  • Unique accommodation (glass igloos & lodges)
Best ForFamilies, couples, honeymooners, bucket-list travellers, festive season travel.

2Where to Stay

Rovaniemi

The capital of Finnish Lapland and the official hometown of Santa Claus, located directly on the Arctic Circle.

Why stay here: The best all-round Lapland destination, with the widest range of activities and accommodation. Easy access via flights from Helsinki and seasonal European connections.

Home to the world-famous Santa Claus Village, open year-round and located right on the Arctic Circle line.

See & do:

  • Meet Santa Claus
  • Cross the Arctic Circle
  • Send postcards from Santa's official post office
  • Husky sledding safaris
  • Reindeer sleigh rides
  • Snowmobile adventures
  • Northern Lights tours
  • Arktikum Museum & Arctic exhibitions

Accommodation style: Glass igloos, riverside lodges, boutique Arctic hotels, family-friendly resorts.

Best ForFamilies, first-time Lapland visitors, Christmas departures.

Tankavaara

A smaller, more remote destination offering a true wilderness experience, located approximately 4 hours north of Rovaniemi, near Urho Kekkonen National Park.

Why stay here: A more intimate and authentic Arctic feel, less commercial and more nature-focused, with excellent Northern Lights visibility thanks to minimal light pollution.

Home to the unique Tankavaara Gold Village, a historic gold prospecting village turned experiential tourism destination.

See & do:

  • Gold panning experiences
  • Aurora hunting
  • Snowshoeing in the national park
  • Cross-country skiing
  • Wilderness dining experiences
  • Sámi cultural encounters

Accommodation style: Log cabins, wilderness lodges, Aurora cabins.

Best ForCouples, adventure travellers, repeat Lapland visitors, clients wanting something different.

3The Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis)

Lapland is one of the best places in the world to view the Aurora Borealis.

PeriodDetail
Best viewing periodSeptember – March
Peak winterDecember – February
Key Selling PointManage expectations, sightings are a natural phenomenon and never guaranteed, but Lapland has excellent success rates during peak season.

4Signature Arctic Experiences

When packaging Lapland, include at least 2–3 core winter activities:

  • Husky safari
  • Reindeer sleigh ride
  • Snowmobile safari
  • Ice fishing
  • Ice hotel visits
  • Arctic floating experience
  • Sámi cultural storytelling

Value-Add Ideas

  • Thermal suits included
  • Small group safaris
  • Private Santa meeting for families
  • Aurora alert service

5Getting There

International clients typically route via Helsinki to Rovaniemi.

Main gateway: Rovaniemi Airport

Tankavaara requires a road transfer from Rovaniemi or Ivalo, there are no trains to Tankavaara, road transfer only.

6How to Package Lapland

Ideal duration:

  • 3–4 nights (short festive break)
  • 4–5 nights (more relaxed experience)
Suggested Combo3 nights Rovaniemi + 2 nights Tankavaara, combining Santa & activities with wilderness & aurora focus.

7Who Does Lapland Suit?

  • Families (especially December departures)
  • Couples wanting a romantic winter escape
  • Honeymooners
  • Luxury bucket-list travellers
  • Clients who have "done Europe" and want something unique

8Selling Tips for Lapland

  • Lapland is an EXPERIENCE destination
  • Set expectations around cold weather (-5°C to -35°C in winter)
  • Sell thermal clothing rental in advance
  • December is high season pricing, position it as a once-in-a-lifetime trip
  • Shoulder season (Jan–March) offers better value
